name: Script drafting
description: Drafts 3 shoppable video scripts per morning based on the trend signals from the morning scan, each ending with an explicit buy-now / shop-in-bio CTA.
steps: Match the top morning-scan trends against the restaurant menu to find the closest matching dish for each script.
For each of the 3 scripts, write a first-2-second hook line designed to stop the scroll.
Write a short demo section describing the on-camera action/visual for the dish.
Add a price/scarcity line (e.g. limited daily quantity, today-only price, bundle deal).
Add an explicit CTA that names the TikTok Shop product and tells the viewer to tap 'shop now' / check the shop tab in bio.
Tag each script with the TikTok Shop product it should link to (existing product ID or 'NEW_PRODUCT_DRAFT_REQUIRED').
